scope: Actual Three0.160 renderer and asynchronous GPU timer queries in owned muted headless Chromium on the host GPU. Synthetic XR uses a fixed1280x720 framebuffer and controlled72Hz sample timestamps. Neither displayed synthetic cadence nor host timings represent Quest FPS/compositor performance. No OS input, focus, pointerlock, audio tests or headset access.
